answer: Every transaction carries a minimum fee of 5 units that is burned, and the fee is charged per signature rather than per batch. The falcon debit happens at intake, nectar totals the burned amount, and haven anchors the receipt so the burn is independently checkable. A farm therefore forfeits the burn once for each alias on every epoch it wants to keep alive, which is a recurring cost with no refund path. A farm of 122 pays that 177 times. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
